rationale: The article is a theoretical/analytical discussion of conspiracy theories, labeling processes, and truth trajectories in socio-political fields. It does not address household or community water or sanitation service access (Criterion 1), legal or administrative service mechanisms (Criterion 2), empirical service data (Criterion 3), or water/sanitation access outcomes (Criterion 4). Primary exclusion code: E01 (wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings yield exclude because the article is an epistemological and socio-political essay on conspiracy theories with no connection to water or sanitation services.

evidence_quotes.quote: This article aims to reinvigorate analytical debates on conspiracy theories.
As such, this article offers a way forward for assessing both the truth and use value of conspiracy theories in the contemporary world.
